radius.$description: dimension used by the dialog component for radius (MarsUI compact Modal master 16414:19665: Radius/big_component/radius_sm 20px; the large variant anchors 24px big_component/radius_md).

padding.$description: dimension used by the dialog component for padding.

gap.$description: dimension used by the dialog component for gap.

min-width.$description: dimension used by the dialog component for min width (surface size scale; the former ki.space.25xl reference misused the spacing scale).

max-width.$description: dimension used by the dialog component for max width (surface size scale; the former ki.space.26xl reference misused the spacing scale).

bg.$description: color used by the dialog component for background (flat fallback of the MarsUI glass gradient: Surface/Special/light-s0_dark-s2; components paint the gradient from ki.dialog.bg-start to ki.dialog.bg-end).

bg-start.$description: color used by the dialog component for the glass gradient start (MarsUI Surface/Special/blur_base_light White/80; dark resolves rgba(36,36,36,0.8)). Paint background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--ki-dialog-bg-start), var(--ki-dialog-bg-end)).

bg-end.$description: color used by the dialog component for the glass gradient end (MarsUI Surface/Special/light-s0_dark-s2: white light / Dark/800 dark).

backdrop-blur.$description: backdrop blur used by the dialog component glass surface (MarsUI BACKGROUND_BLUR Blur/24 = CSS 12px; material3 resolves to blur none via the semantic override; perf-measure before enabling per DNA section 5).

fg.$description: color used by the dialog component for foreground.

border.$description: border used by the dialog component for border (MarsUI 1px solid Outline/base_em Black/3 light / White/3 dark; retires the migrated Black/5 foundation reference).

shadow.$description: Dialog elevation: MarsUI elevation ramp level e4 (brief §5, high modal surface; replaces the migrated approximation). material3 keeps its own e3 override (M3 dialog = level3).

backdrop-bg.$description: color used by the dialog component for backdrop background.

font-size.$description: dimension used by the dialog component for heading font size.

font-weight.$description: font weight used by the dialog component for heading font weight.

line-height.$description: dimension used by the dialog component for heading line height.

color.$description: color used by the dialog component for focus ring color.

width.$description: dimension used by the dialog component for focus ring width.

offset.$description: dimension used by the dialog component for focus ring offset.

duration.$description: duration used by the dialog component for the enter transition (MarsUI moderate step 240ms; retires the migrated 0ms token that disabled the @starting-style fade).

easing.$description: easing used by the dialog component for the enter transition (MarsUI decelerate curve; retires the migrated linear pair).
